projectDescription: Pokpok is an AI-powered brand perception intelligence platform that diagnoses the gap between how humans and AI models perceive your brand — delivering actionable reports in 72 hours at a fraction of legacy research costs.
keyFeatures: X-RAY free scanner — instant HI vs AI perception gap for any URL, 6 metrics, results in ~60 seconds
Brand Perception Truth — deep 17-marker analysis of your brand across two perception lenses (human + AI)
Brand Alignment Truth — compares your Brand Book, website, and Amazon PDP for consistency gaps
Category Perception Truth — monthly subscription scanning 15 category leaders across 17 brand markers
POKPOK Index — weekly intelligence briefing ranking the top 100 Amazon movers by trajectory
5 Uncomfortable Truths — AI-generated strategic insights surfacing white space and oversaturated positioning
Credit system — 3 anonymous scans, +1 on sign-in, +3 on share, up to 7 free X-RAY scans
Claude MCP connector — direct read-only access to POKPOK brand perception data inside Claude
GenAI Treatment (coming soon) — AI-powered content and gallery rebuilds from diagnosed gaps
publicApiSurface: X-RAY scan (POST /scan-url-v2) — submit any URL, returns 6 HI+AI metrics + diagnosis labels
pokpok_about MCP tool — describes POKPOK AI Score and available data tables
pokpok_list_tables MCP tool — lists all 28 public Postgres tables and columns
pokpok_query MCP tool — runs a read-only SELECT query against brand perception data
polar-checkout edge function — creates a Polar checkout session for paid reports
polar-customer-portal edge function — generates a customer portal session token
share-og edge function — serves dynamic OG metadata for shared X-RAY results
claim-share-bonus edge function — awards +3 credits on first share action
